# Components, instances, cells and mixins

The site's components (their tree, props, slots, parts, states, variants and cells), the instances pages hold, and mixins, the named styles nodes take. The header, the footer and each page layout are components too: their parts change inside component.edit.

## instance.insert

Place an instance of one of the site's components (a card, a call to action, a gallery) as child `index` of a parent, with its props and variant. For a whole section of a page use section.insert, for a saved preset preset.insert. Refusals: `unknown_component` (the site has no such component), `duplicate_id`, `invalid_node`; the validator's `instance.overrides` (an override of a node the component lacks).

- **op**; class `structure` (Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

A part of the header shown on every page is in its definition, not on the page. |

## instance.setProp

Set or clear one prop of a component instance: the words, picture, link or choice the component shows from it. null clears it, and the component's default shows. On a list of records (a `json` prop), keep each record's `id` (one without gets one): its translations follow it when records move, and go with it when it goes (undo puts them back). The value must fit the prop's type and choices (`prop_value`); refused for a node that is not an instance (`invalid_input`).

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | { page: uuid } \| { component: string } | yes | Which tree the node is in: `{ page: <pageId> }` for a page's own tree (ids in site_context pages), or `{ component: <key> }` for a definition's own tree (a component, or the header, footer or layout that frames pages; keys in site_context definitions). A part of the header shown on every page is in its definition, not on the page. |
| `node` | string | yes | A node id: 8 characters of a-z and 0-9, unique in its tree (read them in page/<pageId> and node/<pageId>?node=<nodeId>). A node you add takes an id you make up that its tree does not hold yet. |
| `prop` | string | yes | The prop's name, as the component's definition declares it. |
| `value` | string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>> \| null | yes |  |

Example inputs:

```json

```


## instance.fillSlot

Replace everything that fills one slot of an instance: the new parts (`fill`, their root ids in order) with their `nodes`; the previous ones are removed. To add, move or remove one item of a list (a slide, a card), use slot.add, slot.move or slot.remove. Refusals: `duplicate_id`, `orphan_node` (a node under no fill root), `invalid_node`, `invalid_input` (not an instance).

## component.define

Store a new component of the site: its tree, props, slots, named parts, states, variant axes and cells, whole. To make a component from a part of a page, in one batch: component.define with the part's nodes as its tree, tree.remove the part, instance.insert an instance of the new component at its place. `role: 'layout'` makes a page layout (its `main` slot draws the page). Refused when the key exists (`duplicate_key`); the validator checks the tree, the binds and the cells.

## component.delete

Delete a component of the site that nothing uses. Refused while a page or another definition (the header, the footer, a layout, a component) holds an instance of it, or a page has it as its layout (`in_use`: the sentence names them, its paths are their trees: remove or replace the instances there first), and for a key the site does not have (`unknown_component`).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component's key, as the site read lists its definitions (`component.project-card`, `region.header`). |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"component.quote"}
```

## component.edit

Apply tree, repeat and instance ops, tree.duplicate and preset.insert, to one component's own tree as one op. The header, the footer and each page layout are components too (the site read lists them: `region.header`, `region.footer`, `layout.default`), so this changes their parts in one step. Each carried op names the component as its place (`at: { component: <key> }`) and takes the input it takes alone. Refusals: `invalid_input` for an op it cannot carry, an input that op does not take, or another place; any refusal of a carried op.

- **op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "header", "footer".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component's key, as the site read lists its definitions (`component.project-card`, `region.header`). |
| `ops` | ({ name: string, input: string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>> })[] (≤100) | yes | The ops in order, each `{ name, input }` at its current version. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"region.header","ops":[{"name":"tree.set_text","input":{"at":{"component":"region.header"},"node":"hdrcta01","text":"Contattaci"}},{"name":"tree.set_style","input":{"at":{"component":"region.header"},"node":"hdrbar01","scope":"base","declarations":{"background-color":{"$token":"color.bg.page"}}}}]}
```

## component.publish

Give a component a newer version, with the migration that brings the instances of the previous one up (`ops`). Use it when a change to a component's props or parts would break instances made before; an edit that keeps them working needs no new version. Refusals: `version_not_newer`, `unknown_component`.

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

## component.setVariantAxes

Replace a component's variant axes whole, and which of their values are hidden: each axis (a tone, a size) and the values an instance chooses from on it (instance.setVariant). A hidden value (`hidden`, axis → values) is still drawn where a use has it but no longer offered; `{}`: none hidden; without `hidden`, a value hidden before stays hidden while its axis keeps it. A cell key names a value of the `size` axis in its size place and a value of any other axis in its variant place. Refusals: `unknown_component`, `invalid_input`.

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

## cell.set

Set or clear one cell of a component: one style value for a variant, a size, a state, a part and a breakpoint, `*` standing for any. Use it to style a component's variants (a dark tone's background, a small size's padding) apart from its tree's own style. A value is CSS text, a number or a token; a `use` cell (`*.*.*.<part>.*.use`) holds `{ $use: { key, variant } }`, the component that part draws. null clears it. Refusals: `unknown_component`; the validator's `scope.known` (a variant, size, state, part or breakpoint the component does not declare), `css.grammar`, `ref.token`, `definition.use`.

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component's key, as the site read lists its definitions (`component.project-card`, `region.header`). |
| `cell` | string | yes | `<variant>.<size>.<state>.<part>.<breakpoint>.<property>`: a value of a variant axis or `*`, a value of the `size` axis or `*`, a state (`hover`, `focus-visible`, the component's own) or `*`, a part or `*`, a breakpoint or `*`, then a CSS property (or `use`). |
| `value` | string (max 4000) \| number \| { $token: string } \| { $cell: string } \| { $prop: string } \| { $item: string } \| { $state: string } \| { $bind: string (max 80), template?: string (min 1, max 80), fallback?: string (max 200), pair?: { foreground: string (min 3, max 120), background: string (min 3, max 120), theme?: string (… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes |  |

Example inputs:

```json
{"key":"component.section-head","cell":"dark.*.*.root.*.background-color","value":{"$token":"color.bg.inverse"}}
```
```json
{"key":"component.section-head","cell":"*.*.hover.link.*.color","value":{"$token":"color.text.accent"}}
```

## mixin.set

Set or clear one of the site's mixins: a named style every node that lists it takes, so one edit changes them all. A mixin has a label and a style by scope (any scope but `p:` and `sub:`); nodes take it with tree.set_mixins; `mixin: null` clears it. Refused: `mixin.known` (clearing or breaking a mixin nodes still list: the refusal names them, take it off them first).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.
- Found by the plain words: "css".

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (min 1, max 64) | yes | The mixin's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (what tree.set_mixins lists). |
| `mixin` | { label: string (min 1, max 80), style: Record<string, Record<string, string (max 4000) \| number \| { $token: … } \| { $cell: … } \| … \| … \| … \| { $bind: …, template?: …, fallback?: …, pair?: … } \| { $switch: … } \| { $format: … }>> } \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes | { label, style }: its name and its declarations by scope key (any scope but p: and sub:); null clears it. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"didascalia","mixin":{"label":"Didascalia","style":{"base":{"font-size":"0.875rem","letter-spacing":"0.02em","color":{"$token":"color.text.secondary"}}}}}
```

## component.setPresence

Make a part of a component present only while a prop holds a value or a condition on its props holds, or always present (null). An instance whose prop is empty then draws no such part: an eyebrow line, a button without a link. Refusals: `unknown_component`; the validator's `definition.presence` (a part or a prop the component lacks).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component's key, as the site read lists its definitions (`component.project-card`, `region.header`). |
| `part` | string | yes | The part's name, one of the component's parts. |
| `prop` | string \| { prop: string, is: string (max 300) \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| …)[] (≤20) } \| { not: string \| { prop: string, is: … \| … } \| { not: … \| … \| … \| … \| … } \| { all: …[] (≤8) } \| { any: …[] (≤8) } } \| { all: (string \| { prop: …, is: … } \| { not: … } \| { all: … } \| { any: … })[] (≤8) } \| { any: (string… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes | A prop name (present while it holds a value), `{ prop, is }` (while it equals one value or one of a list), `{ not }`, `{ all: [] }`, `{ any: [] }`; null: always present. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"key":"component.section-head","part":"eyebrow","prop":"eyebrow"}
```
```json
{"key":"component.section-head","part":"button","prop":{"all":["link",{"not":{"prop":"tone","is":"plain"}}]}}
```

## component.setSection

Mark a component as a section a person adds to a page (`section: true`), or unmark it. Only a marked component is offered among the sections and taken by section.insert; a layout never is. What it draws does not change. Refused: `unknown_component` (no such definition).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The definition's key (site_context lists the definitions). |
| `section` | boolean | yes |  |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"sticky-bar","section":true}
```

## component.acceptContrast

Accept a text and ground pair that fails AA or cannot be measured for every instance of a component, from a page where an instance shows it. It is a person's decision, the site administrator's: an agent cannot send it, and asks a person to accept the pair in Libretto, or fixes the colour instead. An instance reads the pair as accepted while it measures as it did here. To keep a pair on one page only, a person uses contrast.bypass. Refused: `contrast.not_in_component` (text and ground are not both inside one instance), `contrast.unknown_pair`, `unknown_component`, `duplicate_key` (already accepted), `unknown_page`.

- **op**; class `contrast` (a person: Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component the pair belongs to (component.<name>). |
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | A page where an instance of the component shows the pair; contrast/<pageId> lists its pairs. |
| `text` | string \| "*" | yes | The text as contrast/<pageId> names it (<instance>-<node>), or "*": every text on a ground the component paints. |
| `ground` | string | yes | The ground as contrast/<pageId> names it, inside the same instance. |
| `reason` | string (min 1, max 500) | yes | Why the pair stays as it is, in the words people read in History and on the component. |
| `named` | false |  | Leave out: only an acceptance stored before it named its instance carries it. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"component.project-card","pageId":"3ba4b719-a6fe-4c56-a8a1-ef60cc3586c2","text":"p4c7d2e9-5ktozxpf","ground":"p4c7d2e9-mqk8zeds","reason":"Il grigio del sottotitolo è quello del marchio: lo studio lo tiene su tutte le schede progetto."}
```

## component.unacceptContrast

Take back the acceptance of a pair on a component, named by the component's own node ids: the next write that changes the pair on a page judges it again. Like component.acceptContrast, it is the site administrator's alone; an agent cannot send it. Refused: `op_target` (the pair is not accepted).

- **op**; class `contrast` (a person: Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component that holds the acceptance (component.<name>). |
| `text` | string \| "*" | yes | The text's id inside the component (its own node id, not the page's <instance>-<node>), or "*". |
| `ground` | string \| "canvas" | yes | The ground's id inside the component. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"component.project-card","text":"5ktozxpf","ground":"mqk8zeds"}
```

## component.restoreAcceptance

Put an acceptance back on a component as it was: the undo of component.unacceptContrast and component.dropAcceptance, which Libretto runs when that batch is undone. No one sends it: Libretto writes it, and a batch that carries it is refused as reserved. Refused: `duplicate_key` (the pair is accepted already), `unknown_component`.

- **op**; class `reserved` (no one sends it: Libretto writes it); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component the acceptance goes back on. |
| `record` | object | yes | The acceptance record whole, as the component held it. |
| `record` › `text` | string \| "*" | yes |  |
| `record` › `ground` | string \| "canvas" | yes |  |
| `record` › `ratio` | number ≥1 ≤21 \| null | yes |  |
| `record` › `required` | 3 \| 4.5 | yes |  |
| `record` › `by` | string (min 1, max 200) | yes |  |
| `record` › `at` | string (min 1, max 40) | yes |  |
| `record` › `reason` | string (min 1, max 500) | yes |  |
| `record` › `measured` | string (min 1, max 100) | yes |  |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"component.project-card","record":{"text":"5ktozxpf","ground":"mqk8zeds","ratio":3.9,"required":4.5,"by":"0b7d3c9e-2f41-4a6b-8c5d-1e9f7a3b6c20","at":"2026-11-12T09:30:00.000Z","reason":"Il grigio del sottotitolo è quello del marchio: lo studio lo tiene su tutte le schede progetto.","measured":"9f2c4e71a0b3d58e6c17f4a92b0e3d5c8a61f7e2b49c03d6e8a15f72c4b9d0e3"}}
```

## component.dropAcceptance

Take an acceptance off a component whose text or ground node the batch changed or removed: the contrast check writes it when a batch that edits the component settles, since the edit makes another pair. No one sends it: Libretto writes it, and a batch that carries it is refused as reserved. Undoing that batch puts the acceptance back (component.restoreAcceptance). Refused: `op_target` (the pair is not accepted).

- **op**; class `reserved` (no one sends it: Libretto writes it); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string | yes | The component that holds the acceptance (component.<name>). |
| `text` | string \| "*" | yes | The text's id inside the component (its own node id, not the page's <instance>-<node>), or "*". |
| `ground` | string \| "canvas" | yes | The ground's id inside the component. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"component.project-card","text":"5ktozxpf","ground":"mqk8zeds"}
```
